LanguageData.CPG_AdvancedMode_Description: Shows individual settings for each race.\nDisabling this does not prevent race-specific options (see "Use Race Specific Options".)
LanguageData.CPG_ResetAll_Description: This will restore all the default values of the settings of each race (including [Global Config]) and cannot be undone.\nAre you sure?
LanguageData.CPG_UseRaceSpecific_Description: If enabled, race-specific options will be used (disabling the "Advanced Settings" does not prevent this.)
LanguageData.CPG_CustomAging_Description:
When enabled, allows pawns to have a custom aging speed (in game ticks.)
This option may slow down your game significiantly, particularly on larger colonies.
This does not affect other age-related options.

Requires a restart to take effect.
LanguageData.CPG_GlobalConfig_Description: All races that do not have any modified settings or uses the [Use Global Config] option will refer to this instead.\nSome options will only be applied when necessary (body types for humanoid races only, etc.)
LanguageData.CPG_UngenderedParent_Description:
When enabled, all pawns can either be a mother or father, regardless of gender.
Some have reported this to cause lag, possibly from a mod incompatibility.
If this causes lag for you, please disable this.

Requires a restart to take effect.
LanguageData.CPG_Age_AgeCurve_Description: If enabled, this will attempt to translate a pawn's current age to the new age limit. This may not be accurate but it would generate a similar effect with the vanilla age variation. Disabling this will only clamp the pawn's age.
LanguageData.CPG_Age_HasMinAge_Description: If enabled, this will make sure all pawns can't be below a certain age. This will also affect pregnancy mods, meaning newborn babies will start at the minimum age.
LanguageData.CPG_Age_MinAgeSoft_Description: If enabled, pawns being generated below the minimum age will not be changed (e.g. baby pawns).
LanguageData.CPG_Age_HasMaxAge_Description: If enabled, this will make sure all pawns can't be above a certain age.
LanguageData.CPG_Age_MaxAgeChrono_Description: If enabled, this will increase the pawn's chronological age on every birthday if exceeding the maximum age.
LanguageData.CPG_Age_HasAgeTick_Description: If enabled, allows you to change how fast the pawns age.
